# Chapitre III. Résultats

```{r community data set}
spa_Ndiki<-read.csv2("C:/Users/Windows/AppData/local/RProjets/these_aurelien_vers1/Ndiki_data/Ndiki_cordinate.csv",check.names = FALSE)
spa_Nanga<-read.csv2("C:/Users/Windows/AppData/local/RProjets/these_aurelien_vers1/Nanga_data/Nanga_cordinate.csv",check.names = FALSE)
Ndiki_com_plus<-read.csv2("C:/Users/Windows/AppData/Local/RProjets/these_aurelien_vers1/Ndiki_data/Ndiki_communaute.csv",check.names = FALSE)
Nanga_com<-read.csv2("C:/Users/Windows/AppData/Local/RProjets/these_aurelien_vers1/Nanga_data/Nanga_communaute.csv",check.names = FALSE)
spec.column_Ndiki<-as.character(Ndiki_com_plus[,1])
spec.column_Nanga<-as.character(Nanga_com[,1])
Ndiki_spec<-as.data.frame(t(Ndiki_com_plus[,-1]))
Nanga_spec<-as.data.frame(t(Nanga_com[,-1]))
names(Ndiki_spec)<-spec.column_Ndiki
names(Nanga_spec)<-spec.column_Nanga
```

You can add parts to organize one or more book chapters together. Parts can be inserted at the top of an .Rmd file, before the first-level chapter heading in that same file. 

Add a numbered part: `# (PART) Act one {-}` (followed by `# A chapter`)

Add an unnumbered part: `# (PART\*) Act one {-}` (followed by `# A chapter`)

Add an appendix as a special kind of un-numbered part: `# (APPENDIX) Other stuff {-}` (followed by `# A chapter`). Chapters in an appendix are prepended with letters instead of numbers.
